<!--pixel:start:valtech.carrefourar-maintenance-screen-->
<script >

  function checkDate (maintenanceDateStart, maintenanceDateEnd) {
    const dateFrom = maintenanceDateStart;
    const dateTo = maintenanceDateEnd;

    if (dateFrom === "" || dateTo === "") return true

    const d1 = dateFrom.split("/");
    const d2 = dateTo.split("/");

    const from = new Date(d1[2], parseInt(d1[1])-1, d1[0]);
    const to   = new Date(d2[2], parseInt(d2[1])-1, d2[0]);
    const check = Date.now();

    return check > from && check < to
  }

  (function() {
    const toggleMaintenanceScreen = "false" === "true" ? true : false
    const maintenancePath = "mantenimiento" || "mantenimiento"
    const maintenanceDateStart = ""
    const maintenanceDateEnd = ""
    const currentPage = window.location.pathname

    const isActiveDate = checkDate(
      decodeURIComponent(maintenanceDateStart),
      decodeURIComponent(maintenanceDateEnd),
    )

    const url = new URL(window.location.href)
    const isSiteEditor = url.searchParams.get("__siteEditor") === "true" ? true : false

    if (
      isActiveDate &&
      toggleMaintenanceScreen &&
      currentPage !== `/${maintenancePath}` &&
      !isSiteEditor
    ) {
      localStorage.setItem('regionLocator', '')
      location.replace(`/${maintenancePath}`)
    } else if (
      !isSiteEditor &&
      currentPage === `/${maintenancePath}` &&
      (!toggleMaintenanceScreen || !isActiveDate)
     ) {
      location.replace(`/`)
    }
  })()
</script>

<!--pixel:start:carrefourar.pixel-reorder-hide-->
<script type="text/javascript">
  (function () {
    const account = (window.location.href.indexOf('poccarrefourarg') !== -1) ? 'poccarrefourarg' : 'carrefourar';
    let orderFormCache = null;

    const removeScParam = (url) => {
      const urlObj = new URL(url);
      urlObj.searchParams.delete('sc');
      return urlObj.toString();
    }

    const urlContainsOrderNumber = (url) => {
      const orderNumberRegex = /\/orders\/(\d+(-\d+)?)/;  
      return !!url.match(orderNumberRegex);
    }

    const getReorderButtons = () => {
      const currentURL = removeScParam(window.location.href);
      
      if (urlContainsOrderNumber(currentURL)) {
        const links = document.querySelectorAll('a.f6.link.underline.c-link');
        return Array.from(links).filter((link) => {
          const span = link.querySelector('span.dib');
          return span && span.textContent.trim().toLowerCase().includes('pedido');
        });
      } else {
        return document.getElementsByClassName('myo-reorder-btn');
      }
    }

    const getOrderForm = async () => {
      try {
        if (!orderFormCache) { 
          const response = await fetch('/api/checkout/pub/orderForm', {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Accept': 'application/json',
            },
          });

          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Error en la respuesta: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
          }

          orderFormCache = await response.json();
        }
        
        return orderFormCache;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al obtener el orderForm:', error);
        return null;
      }
    }

    const applyInputRules = (elements, rules) => {
      const inputs = (elements || []).filter(Boolean)

      const sanitizeFn =
        typeof rules.sanitize === 'function'
          ? rules.sanitize
          : (v) => v.replace(rules.sanitize, '')

      const cleanups = inputs.map((input) => {
        const onBeforeInput = (e) => {
          if (!e.data) { 
            return
          } else if (!rules.allowed.test(e.data)) {
            e.preventDefault()
          } 
        }

        const onInput = () => {
          const cleaned = sanitizeFn(input.value)

          if (input.value !== cleaned) {
            const pos = input.selectionStart
            input.value = cleaned
            if (typeof pos === 'number') { 
              input.setSelectionRange(pos, pos)
            }
          }
        }

        input.addEventListener('beforeinput', onBeforeInput)
        input.addEventListener('input', onInput)

        if (rules.inputmode) {
          input.setAttribute('inputmode', rules.inputmode)
        }

        return () => {
          input.removeEventListener('beforeinput', onBeforeInput)
          input.removeEventListener('input', onInput)
        }
      })

      return () => cleanups.forEach((fn) => fn())
    } 

    const hideReOrderButton = async () => {
      const currentURL = removeScParam(window.location.href);
      const disabledSalesChannel = (account === 'carrefourar' ? '3' : '4');
 
      if (currentURL.includes('/account#/orders')) {
        const reOrderButtons = getReorderButtons();
        if (!reOrderButtons || reOrderButtons.length === 0) { return; }

        for (const reOrderButton of reOrderButtons) {
          reOrderButton.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        }

        const orderForm = await getOrderForm();
        const orderFormSalesChannel = orderForm?.salesChannel;
        const regionSalesChannel = orderForm?.customData?.customApps?.find((customApp) => customApp.id === 'region-data')?.fields?.salesChannel;

        if ((!orderFormSalesChannel || (orderFormSalesChannel !== disabledSalesChannel)) && 
            (!regionSalesChannel || (regionSalesChannel !== disabledSalesChannel))) {
          for (const reOrderButton of reOrderButtons) {
            reOrderButton.style.visibility = 'visible';
            reOrderButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
              localStorage.removeItem('withoutStock');
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const enforceAlphabeticInput = () => {
      const currentURL = removeScParam(window.location.href);
 
      if (currentURL.includes('/account#/profile/edit')) {
        const elements = [
          document.querySelector('input[name="lastName"][type="text"]'),
          document.querySelector('input[name="firstName"][type="text"]'),
        ]

        applyInputRules(elements, {
          allowed: /^[A-Za-zÁÉÍÓÚÜáéíóúüÑñ\s]+$/,
          sanitize: /[^A-Za-zÁÉÍÓÚÜáéíóúüÑñ\s]/g,
          inputmode: 'text',
        })
      }
    }

    const helpers = [hideReOrderButton, enforceAlphabeticInput ];

    const useObserver = (targetElement, callback) => {
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => callback(mutations, observer));
      observer.observe(targetElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      return observer;
    };

    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
		  helpers.forEach((helper) => {
        useObserver(document.body, helper);
      });
		});

  })();
</script>
<!--pixel:end:carrefourar.pixel-reorder-hide-->

<script >
  (function () {
    const BLOCKED_TEXTS=[
      "ya no se encuentra disponible",
      "el tipo de despacho fue cambiado",
      "los valores del costo de envío fueron cambiados",
      "no tiene inventario",
      "no se está disponible"
    ];

    function hideInvalidToasts() {
      const toasts=document.querySelectorAll(".vtex-toast-container .vtex-toast");

      toasts.forEach(toast => {
        const text=(toast.textContent||"").toLowerCase().trim();

        const shouldHide=BLOCKED_TEXTS.some(keyword =>
          text.includes(keyword)
        );

        if (shouldHide) {
          toast.style.display="none";
        }
      });
    }

    function initObserver() {
      const provider=document.querySelector(".render-provider");

      if (!provider) return false;

      const observer=new MutationObserver(() => {
        hideInvalidToasts();
      });

      observer.observe(provider, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      });

      hideInvalidToasts();
      return true;
    }

    if (initObserver()) return;

    let attempts=0;
    const maxAttempts=20;

    const timer=setInterval(() => {
      attempts++;

      if (initObserver()||attempts>=maxAttempts) {
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, 300);

  })();
</script>
